authority.message:
Ні, я ж кажу
Клешня повинна бути одна, ліва (якщо дивитись на картинку), справ повинна бути рука з пушкою, клешні не повинно бути там

rootCause: The first correction prompt replaced a spacecraft-reading assembly with a claw rather than removing the separate Alien craft. It also retained the incorrect left gun. The latest director clarification fixes viewer-relative ownership: left claw, right gun, no extra appendage. Historical prompts and image bytes remain unchanged.
prevention: A mixed set's separate opposing model is excluded as a whole object, never converted into a tool. Prompts must declare viewer-relative arm roles, object counts, and DELETE versus REPLACE operations before editing.

inspection.visualFinding: One open two-jaw claw on viewer-left; retained twin-barrel gun arm on viewer-right; extra right pincer and its branch removed. Closed cockpit, tracks, turntable, upright launcher and shoulder attachments visually retained.

boundary: Image-only second correction after explicit director feedback. No other asset approval, production integration, gameplay change or complete T082 acceptance. A further attempt requires new director authority.
